meta.title: Checkout Latency Post-mortem
meta.subtitle: Root-cause analysis for the 2026-09-12 p99 regression

cards.title: Confirmed root cause
items: The orders index was stale after the 13:50 bulk import
Row locks piled up behind the sequential scan
Vacuum had been deferred by the import job

cards.title: Contributing factors
items: Canary stage was skipped for the hotfix deploy
Flash-sale traffic doubled the write rate
Connection pool hit its ceiling under retries

cards.title: Ruled out
items: Bot retries were rate-limited at the edge
Alerting delay only lengthened detection, not the incident
